facts.fact: 一小时后走进酒吧的琼已经不是金发，换成了深色短发、男孩气的瘦削身形。
facts.anchor: THE woman who stepped into the bar an hour later was no longer blond.

facts.fact: 里奥斯坐在最里面的高脚桌旁，背靠墙、眼睛盯着整个场子。
facts.anchor: her back to the wall and her eyes on the room

facts.fact: 里奥斯搂住琼借来的肩膀，琼知道两人衬衫底下有同一个纹身。
facts.anchor: Somewhere underneath the shirt, she knew, they had the same tattoo.

facts.fact: 里奥斯说私人保安这活儿路边炸弹少了、头疼事还是不少，说完就后悔。
facts.anchor: Less roadside bombs. Still plenty of headaches.

facts.fact: 琼一边抠酒瓶标签，一边说自己下周才归队、其实在考虑退出。
facts.anchor: picking at the label on her bottle

facts.fact: 里奥斯正面朝上搁在桌上的手机亮起，来电显示 Leigh，把琼的话打断。
facts.anchor: The screen lit up, and a face and name appeared. Leigh.

facts.fact: 里奥斯拔枪，琼已经把枪按在桌上，啤酒瓶被震得直响。
facts.anchor: By the time Rios drew her gun, June had it pinned to the table

facts.fact: 琼临走留下一张黑桃 Q，号码写在自己的王冠位置。
facts.anchor: a queen of spades, her number scrawled over the crown
